narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Five hundred seventy six ends in six, so its root is twenty six.
<bookmark mark='test'/>Twenty six squared is six hundred seventy six, and that is too big.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>A last digit of six allows a root ending in four or in six.
